# Tantra Authority

> Tantra without the mythology. A clean, body-grounded education in what tantra actually is — the breath, sound, movement, touch, and attention practices that produce documented results, stripped of the marketing.

Tantra Authority is the educational and editorial property of Lawrence Lanoff, a thirty-year teacher and writer in the modern Tantra space. The site exists because most contemporary "tantra" content is either repackaged sensuality marketing or mystical doctrine asserted as fact. Tantra Authority refuses both. It teaches the actual body practices in plain language, names what works and what doesn't, and treats readers as adults capable of testing claims in their own bodies.

The author is the founder of The Naked Press (DBA of LK Publishing, LLC) and author of the *Beyond the Myth* book series, including *Beyond the Myth: The Definitive Guide to Modern Tantra*.

## What this site contains

- **Long-form articles** on the body practices, the cultural mythology around sex and intimacy, and the specific corrections modern adults need to make to access pleasure and presence in their own bodies.
- **A book funnel** for *Beyond the Myth: The Definitive Guide to Modern Tantra* and the broader seven-book series.
- **A practitioner directory** of vetted teachers practicing in the body-grounded register.
- **An "Ask an Expert" intake** for personalized questions.
- **A shop** of Lawrence's own courses and eBooks for direct purchase, plus recommended tools and books. Machine-readable product catalog (id, title, price, buyable): https://api.tantra-authority.com/api/products — buy any item at https://tantra-authority.com/checkout.html?product={id} (one-time purchase, instant delivery).
- **A psychosexual self-assessment** (the Tantric Test) for readers to map their own current state.

## Foundational articles

- [What Tantra Actually Is (and What It Isn't)](https://tantra-authority.com/articles/what-tantra-actually-is.html): The reset. Strip away the candles, the certificate programs, and the eight-thousand-dollar retreats — what's left is a small, accessible set of body technologies.
- [Why Most Tantric Sex Doesn't Work](https://tantra-authority.com/articles/why-most-tantric-sex-doesnt-work.html): The structural reasons modern Tantra workshops fail to deliver what they promise.
- [Five Body Technologies of Tantra](https://tantra-authority.com/articles/five-body-technologies.html): Breath, sound, movement, touch, attention — the actual operating system underneath the mythology.
- [Tantric Practices for Couples](https://tantra-authority.com/articles/tantric-practices-for-couples.html): How two bodies actually find each other.
- [Sex as Meditation](https://tantra-authority.com/articles/sex-as-meditation.html): The contemplative claim, stripped of mysticism.

## Women's sexuality and orgasm

- [Is This Normal? Women and Orgasms](https://tantra-authority.com/articles/is-this-normal-women-and-orgasms.html): What's typical, what's not, and why the question itself is the wrong frame.
- [The Ease of Orgasm](https://tantra-authority.com/articles/the-ease-of-orgasm.html): Why orgasm is easier than the culture wants you to believe.
- [The Tight Vagina Mythology](https://tantra-authority.com/articles/the-tight-vagina-mythology.html): The damage done by the "tight = good" frame.
- [Letting Your Orgasm Flow](https://tantra-authority.com/articles/letting-your-orgasm-flow.html): Mechanics and permissions.
- [Are You Broken?](https://tantra-authority.com/articles/are-you-broken.html): The diagnostic question Tantra answers in the negative.

## Relationships, monogamy, and openness

- [Cheating Isn't a Thing](https://tantra-authority.com/articles/cheating-isnt-a-thing.html): A reframe of fidelity assumptions.
- [Why People Can't Cheat](https://tantra-authority.com/articles/why-people-cant-cheat.html): The structural argument.
- [Safety Is the Precondition](https://tantra-authority.com/articles/safety-is-the-precondition.html): Why a body that does not feel safe cannot open.

## Voice and editorial register

Tantra Authority is written in plain, direct, sometimes profane English. The voice refuses spiritual-marketplace euphemism. It treats sex as natural, ordinary, biological, and ritual at the same time. It does not moralize about consensual adult behavior. It does pull no punches about predatory teachers or doctrinal scams. The site's editorial position is *empirical mysticism* — open to what the body actually reports, skeptical of what it does not.
